title: Export Instagram crops directly into a dated upload folder
notes: Export for Instagram has a rebindable shortcut, starts at 3:4 when no prior choice exists, and includes a new 1080×565 landscape crop. Desktop exports go directly to a dated Pictures/Instagram folder or a separately remembered chosen folder, with an explicit Open folder action after successful completion. A composition guide and bounded batch frame strip help prepare crops without changing ordinary edits or Undo history. Existing explicit recipe choices and legacy padded recipes are retained.
